$comment: Permissions for unattended work. The two wrappers in scripts/ are the enforcement point: they refuse deleting and history-rewriting operations by inspecting every argument, which a prefix rule here cannot do, because a flag moved to the end of the line would not match one. So bare 'git push' is denied on purpose and pushes route through scripts/push. Fixtures are write-denied because document 12 makes their expected values read-only to implementation work; reading them is required and stays allowed.
